rationale: The task is an explicitly read-only, narrow repository readiness precheck with no requested mutation, new product semantics, formal artefact, approval, or release action. Canonical routing assigns local inspection and small reviews to Quick Task Mode.
decision_grounds: The task explicitly requests a read-only precheck of OpenCode provider and agent readiness.
The router classifies questions, small reviews, local debugging, and explicitly scoped inspection as Quick Task Mode.
No implementation, user-visible behavior change, architecture, policy, persistence, release-critical work, or formal AGD
